note: Generated from TECH-SPEC v2 §15 / TASKS.md on 2026-09-05. All epics ready; the ship loop runs until the backlog is empty. Edit with node agentic/scripts/backlog.mjs.

epics.title: Foundation: monorepo, tokens (Palette B), shell, four locales + terminology, audit schema (immutable), sessions core, super admin bootstrap, --demo framework, gates, CI, Compose, sentinel skeleton
outcomes: A developer clones the repo, runs pnpm setup && pnpm dev, and opens the app in uz-Latn, uz-Cyrl, ru and en; pnpm start --demo seeds the demo and shows a demo chip
Every gate in agentic/gates.json runs green on the scaffold, including four-way i18n parity, cross-department isolation and audit immutability tests
First production boot prints a one-time setup URL that creates the super admin; the shell renders in light/dark at 1440/1024/390 with empty/loading/error/offline states
packages/i18n/TERMS.md records real-world Uzbek/Russian terminology with sources; ADR-000…011 exist; infra/sentinel responds to a signed no-op command on localhost only

history.note: foundation accepted on fast gates (typecheck/lint/unit); verification deferred to hardening

epics.title: Accounts: registration (login, password, name, photo, optional title), login, sessions/devices, optional 2FA (TOTP, Telegram code), profile, password reset by super admin or Telegram, account deletion, fresh-account landing
outcomes: Anyone registers in under a minute with name, optional photo and optional title, and lands on "Create a department or join one"
Sessions are server-side with HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite cookies, device list and sign-out-everywhere; login, register and reset are rate-limited without enumeration
2FA is optional for everyone: TOTP with recovery codes works; the Telegram code path is stubbed until EPIC-007
The super admin resets a password to a temporary one that must be changed at next login

epics.title: Departments: create request (name, description, bo'limlar rows), super admin approval → creator becomes head, join key + password, invite sheet (link /join/<key>, QR, localised copy), join by link or form, memberships, settings, switcher
outcomes: A fresh account submits a department request with any number of bo'limlar; the super admin approves; the department exists and the requester is its head
The head opens Invite, sets or generates the password, and "Copy invitation" copies a localised text with the link and password in the current locale

A colleague joins by opening /join/<key> (registering first if needed) and entering the password, or by the join form; a wrong password says only "invalid key or password" and attempts are rate-limited
The head can rotate key/password, require join approval, remove members, transfer headship; every member can switch between their departments

epics.title: Structure: bo'limlar with unlimited nesting, colours, reorder, self-assignment to units and unit roles, org chart that is complete without unit heads
outcomes: Any member creates, renames, reorders and deletes bo'limlar and sub-bo'limlar (delete has undo; people become unassigned) while the head setting allows it
A member assigns themselves as bo'lim boshlig'i, o'rinbosar or a'zo of any unit when self-assignment is on; the head can assign others
The org chart renders a department with zero unit heads and one with three levels of nesting equally well, with keyboard navigation and PNG export

epics.title: Work core: cards (giver → assignee, deadline with risk badge, links, attachments, nested checklist, comments + activity timeline, labels, watchers), People board grouped by bo'lim, quick-add, filter grammar, saved views, table/timeline/calendar/mine, archive, undo, realtime
outcomes: The board shows one column per member under colour-coded bo'lim sections; drag between columns works with mouse and keyboard with live announcements; changes appear on a second browser within a second

A card records who gave it, to whom, by when, links with titles, a nested checklist, comments with mentions and a full activity timeline; done cards leave the board into the person's archive, which any member can read and restore from
Quick-add "Nodira: EGDI paketi, juma" creates a card for Nodira due Friday; assignee:@me due:<=friday is a shareable URL and a saved view; table, timeline, calendar and mine show the same cards
Every list is paginated and virtualised; every write is optimistic with rollback; offline edits queue with a pending badge

epics.title: Group projects: members, objective (shared) and subjective (per-member) tasks, milestones, progress, project page, templates
outcomes: Creating a group project puts one project card in every member's column; objective tasks have one shared state, subjective tasks belong to each member
Project progress is computed from objective and subjective completion; the project page shows milestones, members' loads and the timeline
A project template creates the objective task list in one click

epics.title: Inbox & notifications: reasons, preferences per type and channel, quiet hours, deadline reminders, daily and weekly digests, ICS feeds, optional email
outcomes: Every notification says why it was sent; preferences per type and channel work; quiet hours hold non-urgent delivery
Deadline reminders and digests arrive from pg-boss jobs on schedule in Asia/Tashkent; a person subscribes to an ICS feed of their deadlines and events

epics.title: Telegram: personal linking (/start code + QR), preferences, commands, inline actions, reset and 2FA codes, department group connection by join key with update kinds, weekly summaries
outcomes: A person links Telegram from Settings and receives assignment, deadline and event notifications in their locale with inline buttons that work
A member adds the bot to a group and sends /connect <join key>; the group receives new events, polls and weekly summaries as chosen
No message ever contains personal contact details (serializer allow-list + test); webhook secret verified; reset and 2FA codes arrive by bot

epics.title: Events: create/edit/cancel with change notices, RSVP with guests/change/cancel/waitlist, comments, reminders, carpooling with seats, polls (date/single/multi, anonymous), who-brings-what, photos, feedback, calendar, ICS, illustrations
outcomes: An organiser creates an event in a minute with an illustration; members RSVP, change or cancel before the deadline; the 21st RSVP on a 20-capacity event goes to the waitlist
A driver offers a car with seats and a departure point; colleagues claim seats; a full car shows a waitlist
A date poll and a choice poll (optionally anonymous) run with a deadline and animated results; changing the time or place notifies everyone with the diff; cancellation notifies everyone who RSVPed
After the event, photos (links) and feedback are collected; every event exports ICS and appears in the calendar

epics.title: Personal workspace: sprints (3h/day/week/custom), nested tasks with checkboxes, today/focus, notes, sticky-note canvas (Excalidraw), Pomodoro (defaults 25/5/15/4, editable, sessions, sounds, notifications, shell widget), strictly private
outcomes: A person starts a 3-hour, day or week sprint, adds nested tasks with checkboxes and drags them; nothing here is visible to anyone else, including the head and the super admin view-as
The Pomodoro runs with 25/5/15 defaults, editable in settings, with sounds and browser notifications, a mini widget in the shell, and a session log with stats
The canvas supports sticky notes, drawing and text; it autosaves and restores; a personal task can link to a department card

epics.title: Analytics for everyone: precomputed aggregates, filter bar with the grammar, saved filters, throughput/on-time/load/overdue/projects/events/polls sections, exports, animated charts, pin to Home
outcomes: Any member opens Analytics and filters by person, unit, project, giver, label and date range; charts animate in and export CSV/PNG
No analytics query runs longer than 100 ms on the request path (aggregates precomputed nightly and patched on write); a chart can be pinned to Home

epics.title: Pages & onboarding-lite: how-we-work pages with versions and mentions, onboarding checklist template that becomes a newcomer's personal tasks on join
outcomes: A department writes a how-we-work page with / commands and @mentions; versions can be compared and restored
When enabled, a newcomer's join creates their onboarding checklist in their personal workspace from the department template

epics.title: AI helpers L1 on GLM-5.2: gateway with budgets and traces, quick-add parsing, task breakdown, plan my sprint, risk explanations, weekly summaries, event drafting, thread summary, natural-language analytics filter, translation, what-did-I-miss; evals gate
outcomes: Every AI feature shows a preview and requires an accept before anything is saved; each has a promptfoo golden set that gates CI
All calls go to https://api-llm.gpu.uz/v1 with max_tokens ≥ 1024 and are traced with tokens and UZS cost; a department's monthly budget soft-caps and alerts, then hard-stops
Uzbek (Latin and Cyrillic) and Russian outputs pass the golden set before a feature is on by default; AI can be disabled per department

epics.title: Super admin console: requests queue, departments (view-as read-only, pause, archive), accounts (lock, reset password, 2FA reset, delete), global analytics, audit viewer with chain verification, health, registration toggle, pause switch, wipe switch with host sentinel
outcomes: The super admin approves or rejects department requests with a reason, views any department read-only, and resets a password; every action appears in the audit log with the role
The audit viewer verifies the hash chain and reports the last anchored head; no role, endpoint or migration can update or delete audit rows (CI test)
The pause switch shows the four-locale message on every page and API within seconds while the console stays reachable; the Telegram bot replies with the same message

The wipe switch, after password, 2FA if enabled, a typed phrase and a 60-second countdown, makes the sentinel remove only this project's containers, volumes, code, backups and logs; devon-wipe --confirm does the same from the host shell

epics.title: Hardening & release 1.0: execute agentic/HARDENING.md H1–H30 end to end, write docs/03-plan/PRODUCTION-READINESS.md with before/after measurements, fix everything fixable, tag v1.0.0
outcomes: Every HARDENING.md item is evidenced as done or listed under "requires external configuration" with exact instructions
Before/after measurements exist for request counts, bytes, query counts, LCP/INP/CLS, bundle size, p95 latency at 1/10/100/1000 users, and memory under a 30-minute soak
v1.0.0 is tagged with a four-locale changelog; all gates green in the release profile

epics.title: Telegram Mini App: inbox, board peek, RSVP, polls, Pomodoro companion
outcomes: A member opens the Mini App from the bot, sees their inbox and today's cards, RSVPs and votes; initData is validated server-side; theme follows Telegram

epics.title: AI L2: embedding sidecar, semantic search, ask with citations, related cards, similar projects
outcomes: Search returns semantically related cards the member is allowed to see; answers cite the cards and events they used

epics.title: Automations (five triggers), recurring cards, templates gallery
outcomes: A rule "when a card is done, archive after 3 days" runs without admin help; recurring cards and event/project/page templates cover repeating work

epics.title: Realtime polish: presence on boards, typing indicators, live cursors on canvas
outcomes: Members see who is viewing a board and who is typing a comment; the canvas shows live cursors

epics.title: Calendar sync (CalDAV/Graph) and web push
outcomes: Events and deadlines appear in Outlook/Google calendars; web push works as an opt-in channel

epics.title: Operations: install guide for another server, scripted restore drills, update channel, k3s option, runbooks
outcomes: A sysadmin installs Devon on a fresh server from the guide in an afternoon; a restore drill restores a backup into a scratch environment automatically
